puppies.name: Joleen
puppies.description: Meet Joleen! This sweet baby girl is 5 months old, born June 28th, 2026. Her mom is Jandy of Snowcounty and her dad is Joey of Snowcounty. With her snow-white coat, big dark eyes, and darling little topknot, Joleen is pure sweetness and ready to bring endless love to her new family.

puppies.name: Ginny
puppies.description: Ginny was born on May 10th, 2026. She is a daughter of Casanova and Gabriella. Ginny's estimated adult weight will be around 4.5–5 pounds.

puppies.name: Gabby
puppies.description: Gabby was born on May 10th, 2026. She is a daughter of Casanova and Gabriella. She loves playing with her sister Ginny.

puppies.name: Destiny
puppies.description: Meet Destiny! This adorable sweet baby girl is 6 months old, born May 13th, 2026. Her parents are Darla and Fabio. Destiny is a tiny baby and is expected to be around 3–3.5 pounds as an adult. She is as precious as she looks and can't wait to meet her forever family.

puppies.name: Dasha
puppies.description: Meet Dasha! This beautiful baby girl is 6 months old, born May 14th, 2026. Her mom is Dream Girl and her dad is Bom Bom. Dasha is a loving girl who adores everyone she meets, and she is hoping to find the perfect family to spoil her!
